caption: The drawing depicts a large ceramic jug with a handle and a narrow neck, rendered in shades of beige, brown, and gray, with blue accents. The jug features a painted blue design of a bird perched on a branch with large leaves on its central body. In the upper left corner of the drawing, there is an inset detail showing a close-up of the bird and branch motif in blue on a beige background. In the lower right corner, there is a technical sketch of the jug with dimensions marked, indicating it is 14 3/4 inches tall and 9 inches wide with a neck diameter of 2 3/4 inches. The main composition is framed within a rectangular border. The artist's signature, "Chas Casedy," is visible near the bottom left of the inner border.
title: Jug
